 Learn more Joe Gebbia, the U.S. chief design officer, Airbnb cofounder, and Tesla board member, told Alyson Shontell that Nvidia should reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and then run a due diligence process."Nvidia is one of the greatest companies ever of all time, and it got there because of founder mode," Gebbia said at the F500 Innovation Forum. 
 Video Transcript 00:00 Speaker A I think things seem to have happened very quickly under alleged headlines. 
 00:04 Speaker A And when I say reinstate, it means uh reinstate to then, you know, run a due diligent process, effectively. 
 00:11 Speaker A Nvidia is like one of the greatest companies ever of all time. 
 00:15 Speaker A And they got there because of founder mode, right? Because it's founder led. 
 00:19 Speaker A And so uh, I think it's the right thing to do for shareholders, the right thing to do for the general public, the right thing to do for AI
